featuresTitle: What the new version can do

features.title: A living galaxy
features.text: Graduates drift through our space of craft and memories!

features.title: Several photographs instead of one
features.text: A form can hold more than one photograph. They change right in flight, in chronological order — from a small child to a grown-up.

features.title: Teachers now have their own pages
features.text: Tap the head of the course or a teacher inside a graduate's card and the teacher's page opens — with a surprise on the right-hand side!

features.title: On the future adults page, the order of teachers depends on your forms
features.text: The list on the teachers page is ordered by the number of students: the more graduates mention a teacher in their form, the higher that teacher appears — and subject teachers count, not only heads of course. So it matters to remember and list yours. You can also fill in forms for your groupmates and friends: you almost certainly share performances and the same teachers, so together it goes faster.

features.title: A group can have its own page
features.text: With repertoire by year and recordings, shared photographs, the graduates of the group, its course master and teachers. These pages still need correcting, so look at your own group and write to me with the fixes — I will be waiting.

features.title: Festival trips have their own pages too
features.text: Each one lists who travelled, which productions were taken along, the teachers of the trip and the shared photographs. The lists of participants were restored by correspondence, so mistakes are inevitable: if you were on a trip and are missing, write to me and I will add you.

features.title: Every production now has its own page
features.text: It shows who performed and in which role, the masters, the recording, and whose repertoire the production belongs to. The cast comes from YOUR profiles: a person appears only through their own mention, so nobody is credited merely for having been in the group. If you performed and are missing, fill in the form or write to me.

features.title: New fields in the form
features.text: Teachers as a section of their own, next to the head of the course. Social links are no longer limited to Instagram and Facebook — YouTube works too. And a video card.

note: You can fill in or extend your form at any time. If something is missing or wrong, write to us and we will fix it.
askHint: Hi!) Questions, corrections, a group page — write to me
